description: Implementation of hashtablez sampler functions for profiling and debugging hash tables in the Abseil library.

classes.name: HashtablezInfo
classes.description: Holds profiling information for a hash table instance.

methods.name: HashtablezInfo::PrepareForSampling
methods.description: Initializes profiling data for sampling with given stride and element size.

methods.name: SampleSlow
methods.description: Determines whether to sample based on current state and returns a new HashtablezInfo if sampling.

methods.name: UnsampleSlow
methods.description: Unregisters a hash table from sampling.

methods.name: RecordRehashSlow
methods.description: Records a rehash event and updates profiling info.

methods.name: RecordReservationSlow
methods.description: Records a reservation of capacity in the hash table.

methods.name: RecordStorageChangedSlow
methods.description: Records changes in size and capacity of the hash table.

methods.name: RecordInsertSlow
methods.description: Records an insertion event with hash and probe distance.

methods.name: SetHashtablezConfigListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for configuration changes.

methods.name: IsHashtablezEnabled
methods.description: Checks if hashtable profiling is enabled.

methods.name: GetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns maximum number of samples to collect.

methods.name: SetHashtablezMaxSamples
methods.description: Sets maximum number of samples to collect.
